laterality.instructions: Classify the current patient complaint side explicitly stated in source text. Do not infer from disease. Other subjects do not establish patient laterality.

temporal_classification.instructions: Classify explicit time information only. recent means <=7 days as an engineering label; longstanding >7 days; recent change to a longstanding complaint has its own label. Unknown numeric duration -> unknown.

photopsia.instructions: Classify explicit current patient photopsia statement. Negated -> absent, unmentioned or uncertain -> unknown, inconsistent current assertions -> conflicting.

floaters.instructions: Classify explicit current patient floaters statement. Negated -> absent, unmentioned or uncertain -> unknown, inconsistent current assertions -> conflicting.

missing_fields.instructions: Compare known current patient facts with the documentation profile. Unknown or insufficient fields count as missing. No exam recommendation.

urgency_to_review.instructions: Engineering workflow review hint only. A review guard or conflict yields needs_review, otherwise unknown. Always require human review; never diagnose or declare safe.
